system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Insight and Society, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Lore of a region's history, Astronomy Lore, Lore of an ancient civilization.
system.description: You studied old accounts and disputed their meaning with people just as certain as you were. An unanswered question eventually gave you a reason to leave the safety of your books.
